title: Pokemon TCG Paras Jungle 59/64 Common Card - Lightly Played
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The product is a common English-language Pokémon card from the Jungle set featuring the Grass-type character Paras. Manufactured by The Pokémon Company, this card is part of the Pokémon TCG series and is numbered 59 out of 64. As a collectible card game individual card, it is a sought-after item for Pokémon card collectors and players alike. With its iconic design and specific attributes, the Paras Jungle 59/64 card is a must-have for fans of the Pokémon trading card game.
